rows.traditional: 幫 A 同 B 和好返
rows.jyutping: bong1 A tung4 B wo4 hou2 faan1
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to get two people who have quarrelled to make up again.

example.english: I’ll help the two of them reconcile first; constantly arguing isn’t a solution.
example.traditional: 我幫佢哋兩個和好返先，成日鬧交都唔係辦法。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 wo4 hou2 faan1 sin1 seng4 jat6 naau6 gaau1 dou1 m4 hai6 baan6 faat3

rows.note: Use this for actively removing a disagreement, conflict, or difference rather than restoring a personal relationship.

example.english: We need to sit down and talk to reconcile this misunderstanding.
example.traditional: 大家坐低傾吓，先可以化解呢場誤會。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 co5 dai1 king1 haa2 sin1 ho2 ji5 faa3 gaai2 ne1 coeng4 ng6 wui6

rows.traditional: 令 A 同 B 夾得埋
rows.jyutping: ling6 A tung4 B gaap3 dak1 maai4
rows.note: Use this when making two things, ideas, or arrangements compatible with each other.

example.english: We need to adjust the schedule so the two sides reconcile.
example.traditional: 我哋要改下時間安排，令兩邊夾得埋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 goi2 haa5 si4 gaan1 on1 paai4 ling6 loeng5 bin1 gaap3 dak1 maai4
